purpose: Does upgrading llama.cpp (b11284 -> b11303) help on borg's gfx1151 iGPU? Also tests the issue #24437 signature (rocWMMA FA prefill regression on Strix Halo).

verdict.reason: b11303 is within 1-2% of b11284 (slightly slower) on every metric. No benefit for this workload.
verdict.rocwmma_evidence: FA=1 is FASTER than FA=0 on our build (pp8192: 1217 vs 1104, +10%). Issue #24437 predicts the opposite (FA hurting prefill badly on gfx1151) when the rocWMMA FA path is compiled in. Our prebuilt runtime does not exhibit it.
verdict.prefill_note: ~1200-1280 t/s prefill at 512-8192 depth is strong for this iGPU.
